title: Red Hill Brewery Secret Stash Weekend
summary: Head Brewer David Golding pulls cellar-aged and rare beers (Imperial Stout, Pancho Mole, Christmas Ale, Temptation, Mulled Mead) for guided vertical tastings. Club members get first dibs.
priceRange: Entry from AUD 10 to 30 (tastings priced separately; check website)
accessibilityNotes: Accessible parking; limited mobility path on sloped terrain; contact venue
weatherDependency: Outdoor event, weather-dependent; brewery has indoor covered areas
nearbyAttractions: Polperro Winery; Red Hill Truffles; Foxeys Hangout
suggestedItineraryPairing: Combine with Red Hill wine trail: Polperro; Foxeys; Red Hill Estate; consider Brewer's Cottage accommodation
editorVerdict: The one weekend a year the brewery's cellar comes out. If you care about Australian craft beer, you build the August weekend around this.
editorNote:
Two days in mid-August where David Golding (Red Hill's head brewer) opens the vintage cellar and runs guided vertical tastings of beers most people have never tried: Imperial Stout, Pancho Mole, Christmas Ale, Temptation, Mulled Mead. Members of The Brewer's Secret Stash club book first, then it opens up.

For beer people this is the most serious craft event the Peninsula runs. The grounds are family-friendly during the day so partners and kids can wander while you sit the tasting, but the tastings themselves are adults only.

Wear warm layers, August on the ridge is genuinely cold. Pair with a lunch at Foxeys or a Polperro tasting and stay at the Brewer's Cottage on site if you want to drink properly.
internalNotes: 2026 exact dates not yet announced; estimated mid-August based on annual pattern (16 to 17 Aug 2025; 10 to 11 Aug 2024). Confirm on brewery website.
